title: Unify Board Element Styling States
description: Make board styling consistent across node, edge, handle, and wire. Extend element style support to cover original, neutral, hovered, selected, highlighted, disabled. Add a shared style prop through the board element contract and use it consistently across features. Add a window option for original style, default false, so imported elements such as SVGs can remain unmodified when requested. Validate through focused tests/builds.
summary: Fixed the remaining minimap LOD styling gap by keeping the shared selected/preselect node chrome in the Rust board renderer instead of flattening all minimap nodes to neutral fill-only rendering. Added Rust host coverage that proves minimap preselect adds visible selected chrome. Validation: cargo test -p elements_board --lib preselect_matches_selected_chrome passed; bun nx run @elements/board:test passed Rust tests, wasm-pack, and Vitest, and still reproduces the same two existing Playwright failures in board-play-gpu background menu and redraw toolbar tests.
